newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Presscrete offers 14 million shares at S$0.30 each.
newsitem.headline: Presscrete offers 14 million shares at S$0.30 each.

text.p: Specialist engineering group Presscrete Holdings Ltd launched on Monday its initial public offer (IPO) of 14 million shares at S$0.30 cents each for listing on the Stock Exchange of Singapore's SESDAQ.
Presscrete said in a statement the offer comprises 3.5 million placement shares and 10.5 million offer shares.
At the offer price the shares, which have a par value of S$0.10 each, will represent a price-earnings ratio of 9.46 times.
The offer represents 23.26 percent of the company's enlarged share capital. Up to 3.5 million shares will be reserved for management, staff and business associates.

The statement said Presscrete intends to raise net proceeds of about S$3.8 million from the IPO, to mainly finance purchase of new equipment for expansion of operations in Singapore and the region, and partly to construct a new building in Singapore.
